intro.heading: Four Hours of Simmering Dedication at 21 Boon Tat Street
intro.headline: Four Hours of Simmering Dedication at 21 Boon Tat Street
paragraphs: Founded by Korean entrepreneur Shin Jae-Yoon and Master Chef Nam Wan-Hyuk (trained at Japan's famed Tsuji Culinary Institute with over 15 years developing dining concepts across Seoul, Tokyo, and Hong Kong), GAMJA brings Korea's most cherished comfort food to Singapore's CBD.

At GAMJA, we believe potatoes are never the main character, but the ultimate partner that completes every delicious moment. Absorbing the savory richness of pork broth, softening the fiery heat of flame-torched pork bones, and balancing the hearty depth of our slow-simmered Gamjatang.

Hand-trimmed pork bones are soaked for four hours to eliminate gaminess, blanched clean, and simmered gently on low heat with our secret chili blend of three Korean Gochugaru varieties, fresh ginger, and garlic. Finished with fresh greens, potatoes, and glass noodles right before serving hot at your table.

craftFeature.title: The Honest Simmer: No Shortcuts, Pure Dedication
bodyParagraphs: Making authentic Gamjatang is an unhurried craft. Each batch begins with hand-trimmed pork bones soaked in cold water for four hours to draw out all impurities, followed by a vigorous blanching and thorough cleansing.

Our master broth is seasoned with Chef Nam's signature chili paste: an aromatic harmony of three Korean Gochugaru varieties, aged soy, fermented bean paste, fresh ginger, and crushed garlic. It simmers gently for another four hours until the pork effortlessly separates from the bone.
On the grill, our traditional cast-iron cauldron lid caramelizes thick-cut pork belly, letting the savory pork drippings naturally infuse into aged ripe kimchi and golden potato slices.
bulletPoints: 4+ hours bone soaking and cleansing to eliminate gaminess
Signature chili paste with 3 distinct Korean Gochugaru varieties
Fall-off-the-bone tender meat served with perilla leaves and potato
Traditional cast-iron cauldron lid grilling for premium meats

story.title: When Shin Meets Nam: Bringing Exciting Korean Soul to Singapore
paragraphs: SHIN NAM F&B was born from the harmony of two Korean surnames: Shin Jae-Yoon (The Energetic Host) and Master Chef Nam Wan-Hyuk (The Master Chef). Together in Korean, 'Shin Nam' means 'Exciting'.

After traveling across Seoul, Tokyo, and Hong Kong perfecting recipes for authentic comfort dishes, the duo established GAMJA at 21 Boon Tat Street in Singapore's Telok Ayer district to share true Korean soul food with office workers and dining enthusiasts alike.

During the Singapore F1 Grand Prix, GAMJA had the honor of welcoming Michelin 3-Star Chef Yim Jungsik and the entire Jungsik dining crew, who chose GAMJA as their soul-food sanctuary after cooking at the world-class F1 Paddock Club.

policies: Lunch bookings and dinner walk-ins are welcomed warmly throughout operating hours.
Our signature Cast-Iron K-BBQ is strictly limited to 5 tables per day to ensure pristine meat quality and dedicated grilling service.
Weekend Early Bird: Visit before 12:00 PM on weekends with 2+ guests and order a main dish to receive a complimentary plate of Ppyeogui (Spicy Grilled Pork Bones).
Direct reservation requests via this demo connect directly to the team on WhatsApp with zero booking platform commissions.
